text:
maria (People Ops): Heads-up team - planning a small pilot for a new peer-recognition flow called 'Spark E-cards' next Wednesday. Aim: instant lightweight kudos via email + monthly physical gift for top nominees. Need to confirm image specs, vendor logistics, and tracking for redemptions. Quick ideas? :sparkles:

alex (Design): I can produce design variants. Recs: PNG for email (600x400), GIF for animated hero (700x450), and a 1200x630 preview. I'll add a tiny style guide in Figma and include alt text suggestions. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/spark-e-cards

chris (Logistics): For physical swag, suggest capping at 75 items for pilot to keep fulfillment straightforward. Vendor BrightShip can handle it but needs a CSV with name,address,preferred shipping window. What's our selection rule for recipients?

maria (People Ops): Selection: weekly digital sends, then top 8 recipients across the month get a physical thank-you. Recognition-bot should output a monthly ranked CSV we can send to the vendor. Also want a field for "reason" to capture context.

sam (Eng): recognition-bot can include a free-text "reason" and an emoji tag. We can also add a generated "impact" tag (low/med/high) later for analytics. Webhook for each send is straightforward.

jen (Finance): Ballpark cost: $5 per digital e-card (internal accounting cost) + $20 per physical (swag+shipping). For 75 physicals that's ~$1.5k; pilot ok but need post-pilot spend report. Please cc me on the vendor invoice.

alex (Design): Naming plan: spark_email_v1.png, spark_hero_v1.gif, spark_preview_v1.png. I will include a tiny README in Figma with do/don't and required alt text.

chris (Logistics): BrightShip asked for final CSV by the 22nd. If we launch next Wed, first fulfillment will go out at month-end. Also checking customs requirements for EU shipments and lead times.

maria (People Ops): Action list: Alex - drop final assets and README in Figma by EOD Thurs. Sam - add webhook + monthly CSV export (fields: name,email,reason,timestamp,emoji_tag). Chris - confirm BrightShip rates and EU logistics. Jen - provisional budget sign-off for pilot. I'll draft announcement and sample email copy.

recognition-bot: reminder scheduled: monthly export on day 23 at 09:00 UTC. :robot_face:

sam (Eng): I'll scope the webhook today and post the payload example. Will include the free-text reason and emoji.

maria (People Ops): Great, thanks everyone. Will post final launch schedule once assets + webhook confirmed. We'll run pilot for one month and reconvene for a metrics review (engagement, redemption rate, spend). :tada:
